name: Dufu Technology Corp. Berhad
overview: 2026年公司没有发布与业务板块直接相关的公告，公告主要为季度业绩、股息除权及附加上市（股份拆细）等公司事项。最新一季（2026-09-30）营收同比增长31.3%，净利润同比增长456.3%。
overview_en: In 2026, the company did not release announcements directly related to business segments; announcements were mainly quarterly results, dividend ex-date notices, and additional listing (share subdivision) corporate matters. In the latest quarter ended 30 September 2026, revenue grew 31.3% year-on-year and net profit grew 456.3% year-on-year.
